notes: Unnumbered table: this is the lower panel of the numbered Table 5.18, whose in-table header row prints 'Locations' again with 'Critical Parameter' above the six year columns. It is authored as a separate record so that each record holds a rectangular grid.

Legend printed below the table: A- Drinking Water Source without conventional treatment but after disinfection; B- Outdoor bathing (Organized); C- Drinking Water Source with Conventional treatment followed by disinfection; D- Propagation of wild life and fisheries; E- Irrigation, industrial cooling and controlled waste disposal; CF-Coliform Indicator Organisms.
Allahabad U/S and Allahabad D/S print the 2008* entry as 'CF,BOD', in the reverse order of the other rows. Retained as printed.
Empty printed cells are retained as empty strings; they are not read as zero or as NA.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi full-page PNGs and 288-300 dpi region crops, with sideways pages rotated upright before reading; no OCR, no native-text values, no paid service
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every cell, power, dash, blank and footnote was read from the image and retained as printed; printed anomalies are listed in notes and were not corrected.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent visual comparison against source-region PNGs and rotated or zoomed crops; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every table cell and formula term; checked footnotes, blank cells, numerical outliers and skipped row numbering. Corrected location spelling to printed Raibarreilly after zoomed comparison.
